merge_FSDP_checkpoints: merge FSDP sharded checkpoint weights into a single combined checkpoint saved to an output path
run_merge_weights_cli: run the merge-weights CLI command to merge FSDP checkpoints from a directory to an output path
build_merge_command_parser: build an argument parser for the merge-weights CLI with checkpoint directory and output path arguments
run_merge_command: run the merge command function to merge sharded FSDP weights using checkpoint directory and output path
run_main_entry_point: run the main entry point to parse CLI arguments and execute the FSDP weight merge pipeline
